diagnoses.primary: Abdominal sepsis associated with acute on chronic kidney disease
diagnoses.primary_lay_explanation: A serious belly infection that has spread to the body, happening alongside a sudden worsening of long-term kidney problems.
secondary: Acute perforative abdomen (hole in the intestine)

anomalies_detected.lay_explanation: Blood pressure is lower than normal, which can cause dizziness, weakness, or fainting.
Kidneys are not filtering waste properly, which can lead to toxin buildup in the body.
A pocket of infected fluid or pus collecting inside the belly area.
Too much fluid and waste coming out of the stoma bag, which can lead to dehydration and electrolyte imbalance.

procedures_performed.name: Ileocolectomy
procedures_performed.lay_explanation: Surgery to remove a damaged part of the small and large intestine.

procedures_performed.name: Creation of new anastomosis
procedures_performed.lay_explanation: Surgically reconnecting the healthy ends of the intestine after removing the damaged part.

procedures_performed.name: Transfer to Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
procedures_performed.lay_explanation: Moved to a special high-care unit for close monitoring of vital signs and infection.

medications.name: Ertapenem
medications.purpose_lay: Strong antibiotic injection to fight the belly infection.
medications.timing_dosage: 1 g/day, injected into muscle, for 4 weeks

medications.name: Vancomycin
medications.purpose_lay: Powerful antibiotic to kill resistant bacteria causing infection.

medications.name: Meropenem
medications.purpose_lay: Broad-spectrum antibiotic for serious blood and belly infections.

medications.name: KCL 6% (Potassium Chloride)
medications.purpose_lay: Potassium supplement to keep heart and muscles working properly.

medications.name: Loperamide
medications.purpose_lay: Medicine to slow down bowel movements and reduce diarrhea or high ostomy output.

medications.name: Calcium carbonate
medications.purpose_lay: Calcium supplement to maintain healthy bone and blood calcium levels.

medications.name: Cholestyramine
medications.purpose_lay: Medicine that binds bile acids to reduce diarrhea after intestine surgery.

medications.name: Muciloid
medications.purpose_lay: Fiber supplement to help regulate bowel movements and form stool.

warning_signs_red_flags: Return of fever, chills, or sweating (sign of infection returning)
Severe belly pain, swelling, or hardness
Fainting, extreme dizziness, or very low blood pressure
Significantly decreased urine output or no urine for 6+ hours
Ostomy blockage, no output for 6+ hours, or excessive watery output
Blood in the ostomy bag or dark/black colored output
Shortness of breath or difficulty breathing
